response_metadata.description: Expected HTTP response objects for Node.js tutorial application testing
response_metadata.author: Node.js Tutorial Development Team
response_metadata.usage: Import this fixture in test files to assert expected HTTP responses
notes: All response objects follow HTTP/1.1 specification standards
Status codes align with RFC 7231 HTTP semantics and content standards
Headers include charset specifications for proper content encoding
Error responses use consistent JSON structure for API uniformity
Success responses match the application's documented API contract
Educational purpose annotations explain HTTP concepts and best practices
Response structures support both unit and integration testing scenarios
All responses are designed for educational clarity and maintainability
Security considerations are reflected in error message sanitization
